propositions: Unit-tier tests spawning subprocesses without taking their root from the harness silently drop REBAR_ROOT and fall back to the real git checkout, causing isolation violations in ~15.8% of the defect stream.

No enforcement mechanism currently prevents new unit-tier tests from building ad-hoc subprocess environments (env dict literals, cwd overrides, or home path defaults) that bypass the harness isolation root.

An AST-based predicate must detect subprocess spawn sites (subprocess.run, Popen, os.system, os.popen, pytest.main) that lack proper harness integration, raising pytest.UsageError with an instructive message during collection.
Statically undecidable sites (env=<bare variable> without def-site trace) must be reported but not failed to prevent false reddens on existing code.
The opt-out marker @pytest.mark.allow_unharnessed_subprocess requires a mandatory non-blank reason string, enforced during collection, to keep opt-out growth greppable and countable.
All ~26 identified hazard sites (env dict literals without REBAR_ROOT, cwd=REPO_ROOT overrides, HOME reads) must be fixed or explicitly marked before the guard is active.
